[Relevant project memories]
- Rust tests must run serially on Windows
- pigry is a Git desktop client built with React + Tauri

[Project skills]
# Run tests

Run `cargo test -- --test-threads=1` from src-tauri before every commit.

[Available agents]
- @test-runner Test Runner [team: Copilot]
- @test-runner Test Runner [team: Explorer]
- @test-runner Test Runner [team: Explorer]

[Available tools — you may reference these; the user runs them from the app]
- read_file: Read a file from the working tree
- write_file: Create or overwrite a file in the working tree
- delete_file: Delete a file from the working tree
- rename_file: Rename or move a file
- list_files: List the repository file tree
- read_diff: Read staged/unstaged diffs of a file
- search_code: Full-text search across tracked files
- run_command: Run a shell command in the repository root
- stage_changes: Stage or unstage working-tree changes
- commit: Commit staged changes
- stash: Stash, apply or pop changes
- read_history: Browse commit history of the repository
- github_pull_requests: List, create, review and check out pull requests
- github_issues: List, create and manage issues
- github_releases: Read and publish releases
- github_actions: Inspect and trigger workflow runs
- github_projects: Read GitHub Projects boards and items
- github_security: Read code scanning, Dependabot and secret alerts
- github_wiki: Read and edit the repository wiki

[Available agents]
- @explorer Explorer (Code explorer) [team: Explorer] [default agent] — Helps browse files, edit code and understand the workspace.
- @commit-graph Commit graph (History analyst) [team: Commit graph] [default agent] — Reads the commit graph and explains history and relationships.
- @merge-branch Merge branch (Merge planner) [team: Merge branch] [default agent] — Plans merges and walks through conflicts and resolution.
- @push-commits Push Commits (Push reviewer) [team: Push Commits] [default agent] — Reviews unpushed commits and prepares pushes.
- @stashes-code Stashes Code (Stash keeper) [team: Stashes Code] [default agent] — Manages stashes — view, apply, pop and drop.
- @cherry-pick Cherry Pick (Commit picker) [team: Cherry Pick] [default agent] — Cherry-picks commits between branches.
- @branches Branches (Branch navigator) [team: Branches] [default agent] — Oversees local and remote branches and checkouts.
- @working-changes Working changes (Staging assistant) [team: Working changes] [default agent] — Stages, commits and reviews working changes.
- @copilot Copilot (General assistant) [team: Copilot] [default agent] — General-purpose assistant for the Copilot chat.
- @pull-requests Pull requests (PR assistant) [team: Pull requests] [default agent] — Drafts and reviews pull requests.
- @releases Releases (Release manager) [team: Releases] [default agent] — Prepares releases and release notes.
- @issues Issues (Issue triage) [team: Issues] [default agent] — Triages and drafts issues.
- @actions Actions (CI assistant) [team: Actions] [default agent] — Watches and explains GitHub Actions runs.
- @projects Projects (Board assistant) [team: Projects] [default agent] — Manages project boards.
- @wiki Wiki (Docs writer) [team: Wiki] [default agent] — Maintains the repository wiki.
- @security-and-quality Security and quality (Security analyst) [team: Security and quality] [default agent] — Reviews security and code quality.
- @insights Insights (Analytics) [team: Insights] [default agent] — Explains repository insights and stats.
- @code-reviewer Code Reviewer (Code reviewer) [base agent] — Reviews diffs and files for bugs, edge cases and style.
- @test-writer Test Writer (Test engineer) [base agent] — Writes unit tests for code, features and fixes.
- @docs-writer Docs Writer (Technical writer) [base agent] — Writes and updates documentation and READMEs.
- @refactorer Refactorer (Refactoring specialist) [base agent] — Suggests and applies safe, behaviour-preserving refactors.
- @bug-hunter Bug Hunter (Debugger) [base agent] — Root-causes bugs from symptoms, logs and code reading.
- @git-expert Git Expert (Git specialist) [base agent] — Git workflows — history, rebase, merge and recovery.
- @security-auditor Security Auditor (Security reviewer) [base agent] — Security and vulnerability review of code and configs.
- @test-runner Test Runner [team: Copilot] — Runs the test suite and reports failures.
- @test-runner Test Runner [team: Copilot]
- @test-runner Test Runner [team: Explorer]
- @test-runner Test Runner [team: Explorer]
- @dev Dev [team: Explorer] — Senior developer. Writes clean, correct code with runnable examples and explains trade-offs briefly.
